changelog: Affiliate: export a programme's settings (page content and theme with its media, contract, customer status, window notice, referral address, commission plan) as one JSON file and import it in another environment — preview first, every section through its own writer, the plan only with an explicit confirmation (#3622).

en: Partner programme: download the programme's settings as one file and load them into another environment — page, theme and pictures, contract and more. The commission plan is only loaded if you confirm it.
tr: Partner programı: programın ayarlarını tek bir dosya olarak indirip başka bir ortama yükleyin — sayfa, tema ve görseller, sözleşme ve diğerleri. Komisyon planı yalnızca onaylarsanız yüklenir.
de: Partnerprogramm: Laden Sie die Einstellungen des Programms als eine Datei herunter und spielen Sie sie in einer anderen Umgebung ein — Seite, Design und Bilder, Vertrag und mehr. Der Provisionsplan wird nur nach Ihrer Bestätigung übernommen.
